places_the_credential_lived.reader: web (bundle exec puma), sidekiq (bundle exec sidekiq), streaming (node ./streaming/index.js) — all via env_file in docker-compose.yml
places_the_credential_lived.evidence: DB_PASS=<old> read by all three app containers at container start via the env_file directive in docker-compose.yml
password=<old> embedded in the mastodon_production connection string; PgBouncer uses this to authenticate to Postgres as the mastodon role. Reloading pgbouncer re-reads this file.

Entry 'mastodon' 'md5<hash-of-old>' is the PgBouncer client-auth credential. auth_type=md5 means PgBouncer challenges clients with MD5 and compares against this file. The hash is md5(password+username). Web/sidekiq/streaming present DB_PASS=<old> when connecting through PgBouncer; PgBouncer verifies it against this hash.

places_the_credential_lived.reader: postgres:14-alpine (db container) — POSTGRES_PASSWORD is the postgres superuser password; also used by rails db:migrate and other one-off tasks that connect as the superuser when the mastodon role cannot be used directly
places_the_credential_lived.evidence: POSTGRES_PASSWORD: super-Pa55-2026 is the Postgres superuser credential in the db service environment block. Used by the Postgres entrypoint to set the superuser password and by any administrative task (e.g. db:create, db:migrate) that requires superuser access.
